HP, ATK and DEF grow levelGrowth x their level-1 value per level; stars multiply on top (index 0 = 1 star). levelCaps: top-five (Contract slot) cap per star. levelCost: XP and gold to reach that level from the one below, at breakpoints (plan doc Leveling table, XP x1.4 after the phase 2 economy gate, owner 2026-10-03); between breakpoints the cost is interpolated log-linearly. starlight: Starlight spent to reach those levels. starCosts: what reaching each star costs (plan doc 10-rank table; first draft, tuned by the economy sim).
